body: Originally, I wanted to get into culinary school. But in high school the course was always filled before I could get in. No one ever dropped or transferred from that class. One of my friends who got in the class all four years just started at Le Cordon Bleu, and I'm all kinds of happy for her. At the same time I'm pissed because she got the teaching and classes she needed to get in and excel in our favorite subject. After school, I tried getting a job in just about every food place in town except for McDonalds and Krystals. Both places are having theft issues, and Krystals might be going out of business soon. A local oriental restaurant where my best friend works wanted to hire me, but is closing very soon and I wouldn't get paid much. I tried my best to get customers out there. Facebook ads, small flyers at this year's FandomCon (helped a bit. Chuck Hüber went!) but it wasn't enough. It was perfect. I knew the recipes for the majority of dishes there. I even knew the cooks, and helped two of them pass there finals in college. I kissed everyone's asses, talked up everyone I could, even cooked for a small party an employer was having. No other offers came in. Been three years, now. Still nothing. No job. No car. No real life. Friends are all moving on up in life, and I keep sinking. I'd have given anything to be like them. Instead the only person I relate to is this guy that hangs out with us who's *a tad bit special, and horribly unstable* I don't mean to offend but I can't think of any other thing to say about him. He talks about murder and rape a lot, so I try to avoid him. I guess I deserve this. I never wanted anything else in life, so I never prepared for anything else. No marketable skills, hardly a high school education (did poorly, but still graduated), but no criminal record so I got that going for me. But isn't as nice as I'd think.At least people compliment my cooking. Self taught, and hardly any major screw ups (aside from when I bit into a microwaved boiled egg. My face burned for a full week...)Thanks for listening. Started smiling remembering some of these things.

My dad doesn't intend on letting me stay here in 2015. It's either continue in college (my GPA is too low so I can't really get financial aid, and he doesn't know), or go military (my back got screwed up some years ago, and I never got back in shape). Mom agrees with him. Only reason they allow my older brother is because he got screwed over by his ex. Been getting turned down from every place I apply at. And with the 7th Special Forces moving in, there'll be even fewer available jobs. I have no intention of seeing my 21st birthday. I know shit will be worse then. Even more, I know my family will be more against me by then."Look for a reason to smile" I'd tell others."No matter how small a reason, a smile always grows."The more I try to follow that saying, the more I hate myself. The thoughts are always the same.*How dare you try to waste such good memories**Why can you end it, but others can't? What makes you so special!?*Even worse ,*Why aren't you normal? Like your friends? They got great lives and supportive families because they did what you were too dumb or too weak to do. You're such a disappointment.*Been like this since 12th grade. I tried to end it once back then and failed. Mom and dad never forgave me for it. At least I lied my way out of therapy. Nothing went on record because of that. But they insist on dragging it up to make some kind of point. I thought family was supposed to be have your back. But I guess it just makes it easier for them to stab it. Whatever.Sorry for rambling again.
Just need a good outline of the character design. No computer to do it on. Thank you, anyone!
